description: This file contains asynchronous service functions for CRUD operations on modem objects, utilizing SQLAlchemy with an async session. It provides functions to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete modem records in a database.

methods.name: Modem create_modem(session: AsyncSession, payload: ModemCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new modem record in the database with the provided payload.

methods.name: list[Modem] list_modems(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all modem records ordered by their ID.

methods.name: Modem|None get_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a modem record by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Modem update_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem: Modem, payload: ModemUpdate)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing modem record based on the provided payload.

methods.name: bool delete_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a modem record by its ID, returning True if deletion was successful.

ctags.name: create_modem
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_modem(session: AsyncSession, payload: ModemCreate) -> Modem:$/

ctags.name: delete_modem
ctags.pattern: /^async def delete_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem_id: int) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: get_modem
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem_id: int) -> Modem | None:$/

ctags.pattern: /^async def update_modem(session: AsyncSession, modem: Modem, payload: ModemUpdate) -> Modem:$/
